## Summary

I've resolved ticket T-2009. The issue is not a Kubernetes problem—it's an application bug in pricing-engine v4.11.3. The pods are crashing with a panic error when compiling a pricing rule "BF-2026-STACKED" due to an array index out of bounds error in the tier compilation logic. Kubernetes is correctly applying exponential backoff restarts as designed. The ticket owner needs to contact the pricing-engine development team to patch the code, or temporarily disable the problematic pricing rule to restore service.
